comment: The standard library's table. One row breaks the SHA-256 compression
function of std/digest/sha256.ft (FIPS 180-4 6.2.2). A std module is
not part of the compiler binary, so the md5 guard reads the copy of the
module in the standard root of the debug preset. The build copies the
module there itself: the target fort_std copied nothing in 2 of 3
rounds, so those rounds read stale. The stage runs the
two module tests of test/fort/std/digest/. The table runs in the VM with
the default runner after `tools/vm configure` and `tools/vm build`.

stages.name: the digest module test
stages.command: python3 test/lang/run_tests.py --root test/fort --fort build/Linux/debug/fort --std-dir build/Linux/debug/std --verify-ir std/digest/

mutations.what: Maj(a, b, c) takes b | c for its third term, not b & c
